reference_works: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex (2002-2005)

sources.name: Ghost in the Shell (1995) - Blu-ray Frame Extraction
sources.description: Frame extraction from the 1995 Mamoru Oshii film. Focus on cityscape establishing shots, diving sequence, market chase, Puppet Master scenes, and atmospheric rain/water sequences.
sources.notes: Subtitle-free audio track recommended. If hardsubbed, crop bottom 120px of 1080p frames.

sources.name: Akira (1988) - Blu-ray Frame Extraction
sources.description: Frame extraction from the 1988 Katsuhiro Otomo film. Priority scenes: Neo-Tokyo cityscapes, motorcycle chase, Kaneda vs Tetsuo confrontations, SOL satellite, stadium sequences, Akira chamber.
sources.notes: Akira's hand-drawn quality means nearly every frame is usable. Be selective to avoid over-representing action scenes.

sources.name: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex - Blu-ray Frame Extraction
sources.description: Frame extraction from SAC Season 1 and 2nd GIG. Focus on city infrastructure, Tachikoma scenes, Section 9 operations, and holographic UI overlays.
sources.notes: Lower extraction rate (1 frame per 5 seconds) since series has more dialogue scenes. Cherry-pick episodes with strong visual set pieces.

sources.name: Danbooru - Ghost in the Shell Official Art
sources.description: Official artwork, key visuals, and production art for the Ghost in the Shell franchise tagged on Danbooru.
sources.notes: Filter by highres tag. Manually review for quality. Exclude heavily JPEG-compressed images.

sources.name: Danbooru - Akira Official Art & Screencaps
sources.description: Official Akira artwork, manga color pages, and key visuals. Also search with screencap tag for film stills.
sources.notes: Akira manga color pages are excellent style references. Film screencaps may duplicate src-002.

sources.name: Danbooru - Cyberpunk Anime Cityscape
sources.description: High-resolution cyberpunk cityscape images in anime style. Captures the environmental aesthetic without character-specific content.
sources.notes: Good for environment variety. Manually exclude images that don't match the target aesthetic.

sources.name: Safebooru - Cyberpunk Neon Aesthetic
sources.description: SFW-filtered cyberpunk images with neon lighting and night settings. Safe for training without content concerns.
sources.notes: Supplementary source. Use to fill gaps in specific visual categories (e.g., more neon signage, rainy streets).

sources.name: The Art of Ghost in the Shell (Art Book Scans)
sources.description: Production background art by Hiromasa Ogura, character design sheets, color scripts, and layout drawings from the 1995 film.
sources.notes: Background art is especially valuable -- it captures the painterly cityscape style uniquely. Correct for page curvature near spine.

sources.name: Akira Club / Akira Animation Archives (Art Book)
sources.description: Otomo's original color illustrations, production backgrounds, key animation frames, and color reference sheets.
sources.notes: Otomo's color illustrations are the purest expression of the Akira style. Essential for the dataset.

sources.name: Psycho-Pass - Selective Frame Extraction
sources.description: Frame extraction from Psycho-Pass Season 1, focusing on Sybil System city environments, holographic UI, and dark urban scenes.
sources.notes: Supplementary source only. Episodes 1, 11, 16, 22 have the strongest cyberpunk city visuals.

sources.name: Bubblegum Crisis (1987 OVA) - Frame Extraction
sources.description: Classic 80s cyberpunk OVA. MegaTokyo cityscapes, Knight Sabers hardsuit designs, and Genom Tower environments.
sources.notes: Valuable for capturing the specific 80s anime cyberpunk look that influenced both GitS and many later works. May need Real-ESRGAN upscale.

sources.name: Pixiv - Cyberpunk Anime Illustrations
sources.description: Professional and semi-professional cyberpunk anime illustrations. Filter by bookmark count for quality.
sources.notes: Only include images that match the GitS/Akira aesthetic. Exclude modern 'neon girl' style that looks more like Cyberpunk 2077 than classic anime.

excluded_sources.name: Low-quality streaming screenshots
excluded_sources.reason: Compression artifacts from streaming services produce training artifacts

excluded_sources.name: AI-generated cyberpunk anime images
excluded_sources.reason: Training on AI-generated images causes quality degradation and style drift

excluded_sources.name: Cyberpunk 2077 / Edgerunners content
excluded_sources.reason: Different visual style (more Western/digital painting). Would dilute the classic anime aesthetic.

excluded_sources.name: Manga pages (black and white)
excluded_sources.reason: Style LoRA targets color aesthetic. B&W would confuse color learning.
